# Showband Group

> Showband Group — Bakıda toy, nişan, korporativ tədbir, ad günü və party üçün canlı musiqi: instrumental band, DJ, showman, müğənni, səs-işıq və şou proqramı. Azərbaycanın rayonlarında və xaricdə də çıxış edir.

Showband Group (Baku, Azerbaijan) is a live music and event show band for weddings, corporate events, birthdays and parties. Services: instrumental band, DJ, showman/host, singer or guitarist, live rhythm ensemble, flash mob, event script, sound system and show effects. Performs across Azerbaijan and abroad.

Booking: WhatsApp +994 55 611 87 87 (https://wa.me/994556118787), Instagram https://www.instagram.com/showband_group/, or the form at https://showbandgroup.az/#bron

## Packages (Baku prices)

- Toy Disko — 600 AZN, 1 hour: DJ in an LED outfit + live percussion (darbuka, davul, afro), world hits, 70s-90s, disco and halay, flash mob, money and confetti guns, LED sticks. Smoke gun +100 AZN.
- Mega Disco Show — 800 AZN (1000 AZN if booked separately), ≈1 h 25 min: Showband Instrumental Band (20–25 min) followed by the 1-hour Toy Disko; smoke gun included as a gift.
- Kino Açılış (movie-themed wedding opening) — from 1000 AZN: custom script, classic film characters, dance group, DJ Orxan Abbasov remixes of old film music, live rhythm instruments, grand entrance of the couple.
- Engagement (Nişan) package — 1500 AZN, full event: sound system, host and script, tar, singer with 4 live musicians, rhythm instruments, Showband instrumental (20–25 min), DJ, 1-hour disco.
- Birthday (Ad günü) package — 1000 AZN, full event: sound system, host and script, tar, rhythm instruments, Showband instrumental (20–25 min), DJ, 1-hour disco. Singer optional.
- Graduation & Party (Məzun gecəsi) package — from 1000 AZN: sound system, custom script, host-showman, DJ, Showband instrumental (20–25 min), 1-hour full disco with props.
- Corporate package — from 2000 AZN, all-inclusive with travel: preparation and company quizzes, tar welcome, MC, contests with prizes, singer-guitarist, show band (20–25 min), rhythm ensemble, 1-hour full disco, sound system (6 speakers, 2 mics).
- Instrumental Band — 300 AZN (25 min, 3 soloists in LED outfits, fireworks and money-rain effects); Band + DJ — 500 AZN (≈35–40 min).

Add-ons: LED glasses and flash-mob sticks 100 AZN; reels maker (videographer) 200 AZN; singer, guitar group, dance groups on request.
Prices are for Baku; regions, holidays, hotels and some restaurants may differ. Full catalogue (PDF): https://showbandgroup.az/files/Showband_Paketler_2026.pdf
